subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Should the bundled github-copilot provider accept allowlisted GitHub Enterprise data-residency tenant routing through device-enterprise, COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN, and models.providers.github-copilot.params.githubDomain?
rationale: The code review can validate implementation shape, but accepting new token destinations, config/env surface, and SDK helper expansion is a provider/security boundary decision.

options.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
options.body: Approve the provider-owned github.com plus single-label *.ghe.com design and land after exact-head gates and owner/security signoff.

options.title: Require a generic host-routing seam first
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers define a reusable provider-auth tenant-host contract instead of provider-specific helper exports.

options.title: Move enterprise routing out of core
options.body: Reject this bundled-provider change and require a separate plugin/ClawHub package for the enterprise-specific behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
recommendation.body: Approve the provider-owned github.com plus single-label *.ghe.com design and land after exact-head gates and owner/security signoff.

likelyOwner.reason: This reviewer is the current assignee and has already framed the remaining decision as owner/security acceptance of this exact boundary.
